{{Top|leg}}
'''Yoro''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] whose roots could be used to make pigment for [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooing]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had a Yoro root pigment tattoo.
